# Environment config register

> **Generated - do not edit. Names only, never a value.** Source: AA-CIS-Infra Docs Gen (AA-894 env-config first run), https://github.com/AdventureAsia365-Ecosys/AA-CIS-Infra/actions/runs/39734484462. AA-CIS-Infra
> `tools/docs/gen_env_config.py` renders it nightly from the live ECS task definitions, Lambda configurations and
> Vercel projects; a secret is listed by its store name and never read. To change a row, change the app's
> Terraform, task definition or Vercel project.

What every runtime of the Dev ecosystem is configured with, by **name**: the ECS services of cluster `aa-cis-dev-cluster`, every Lambda function of acc2 and every Vercel project. Values are never read for this page; a secret is named by its Secrets Manager secret (or SSM parameter), which the [secrets register](../security/secrets-register.md) describes (owner, readers, rotation).

- **Source** (ECS, Lambda): `plain` = a value in the task definition or function configuration; `secret` = injected at start from the named secret (ECS `secrets[]`).
- **Kind** (Vercel): `sensitive` = write-only, nobody can read it back; `readable` = encrypted at rest but a project member can read it.
- **Note** flags a name that looks like a secret in a plain or readable variable (same rule as the AA-878 register drift check).
- Vercel rows are from the checked-in snapshot AA-CIS-Infra `tools/docs/env_config_vercel.json` (captured 2026-10-22 with `vercel env ls`; the Docs Gen workflow has no Vercel token).

**Totals:** 4 ECS services (57 variables, 14 from a secret), 8 Lambda functions (41 variables), 4 Vercel projects (33 variables).
